problem: How are the unary observation residue and the newly activated ternary coherence related under one-grade pyramid extension?
bold_conjecture: Both extension residues are supported on the newly appended cell.
named_rivals: one-step staggering: observation adds the new cell while coherence activates the old terminal cell
acceptance_tests: observation residue is the new cell
coherence residue is the former terminal cell
shift transports coherence support to observation support
two residues are orthogonal at every finite extension
claim_boundary: Exact finite support theorem for the staggered unary and ternary extension residues. The one-step lag is grade/cutoff structure, not temporal delay.
